results.missing: shared image checked once; both affected questions excluded without clearing selection

results.retry: fixed image decoded; questions restored; URL cache reused across selection changes

results.cancellation: removing pending media questions cancels probes; late results do not alter selection or block launch

results.invalidMime: HTML fallback excluded; explicit keep preserves runtime error and skip fallback

results.originPolicy: unapproved origin blocked before network, including explicit keep at runtime
